Therefore, while fat may weigh the same as muscle, it will take up more space due to its lower density. This is why athletes and bodybuilders often strive to maintain a low body fat percentage, as it allows them to appear more muscular and defined.

It's worth noting that this is an assumption, as the exact density of muscle and fat tissue can vary depending on individual factors such as body composition and hydration levels.
